title: M1 Pro Gloss Black

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Tailored for classic roadsters and urban cruising, the Schuberth M1 Pro Gloss Black delivers breezy open-air freedom for scenic cruising and city exploration. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell tips the scales at a featherweight 1144g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~95 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE impact standards. The interior features a plush, moisture-wicking crown liner shaped for Intermediate Oval head shapes, secured by a glove-friendly Micro-Lock Ratchet retention system for effortless warm-weather riding.

product_details.description: Perfect for naked bikes and cruisers with pre-installed comms.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Open face design; requires separate chin bar or conversion kit for full-face protection.

technical_analysis: Features Direct Fiber Processing (DFP) glass fiber reinforced with carbon matrix tuned in Magdeburg acoustic wind tunnels paired with City-position visor ratchet system with integrated drop-down sun visor and pre-installed Sena SC2 Mesh antenna. The interior utilizes Seamless individual customizable lining with Anti-Roll-Off System (AROS) for neck retention stability with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Schuberth M1 Pro Gloss Black: combining Germany 🇩🇪 craftsmanship with City-position visor ratchet system with integrated drop-down sun visor and pre-installed Sena SC2 Mesh antenna and Seamless individual customizable lining with Anti-Roll-Off System (AROS) for neck retention stability. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Schuberth's Open Face lineup, the M1 Pro Gloss Black brings German engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE track safety.
story:
The Schuberth M1 Pro Gloss Black represents Schuberth's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~95 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) Open Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Schuberth M1 Pro Gloss Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
